The study titled Feed rate on the risk of refeeding syndrome: a pilot study, published in the Journal of Human Nutrition & Dietetics in December 2009 (Volume 22, Issue 6, Pages 592–593), investigates the relationship between the rate of nutritional reintroduction and the development of refeeding syndrome. 2. Boateng AA, Sriram K, Meguid MM, and Crook M authored a paper titled Refeeding syndrome: treatment considerations based on collective analysis of literature case reports, which was published in Nutrition in February 2010 (Volume 26, Issue 2, Pages 156–167). This study provides a detailed analysis of case reports from the literature to offer insights into the management and treatment of refeeding syndrome.
